newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover up 0.6 pct 3mths to Aug.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover up 0.6 pct 3mths to Aug.

text.p: Total turnover of UK engineering industries rose by 0.6 percent in the three months to August compared with the previous three months, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
The rise was due to a 0.7 percent increase in export turnover and a 0.6 percent rise in home turnover.
Compared with the same period a year ago, total turnover increased by 2.9 percent, the ONS said.
Total orders on hand at the end of August, were 3.3 percent lower than they were at the end of May and were 5.7 percent down on August 1995.
